candidates.name: EP Prime Blinds and Specialties (EP Prime Investment Inc.)
candidates.reason: Its Toilet Partitions page says it handles toilet partitions 'from plan review and product coordination through installation' for schools, offices, healthcare and public buildings in El Paso, and it shows six photos of recent partition jobs. Brands appear only as an image with no text, and it helps clients choose products, so it may also supply partitions.
candidates.partition_evidence: services/toilet-partitions.html: 'through installation', 'Recent toilet partitions work' gallery (6 photos); homepage lists Toilet Partitions and Division 10 commercial specialties
red_flags: Also a blinds/window treatment business; partitions may be supplied as well as installed (buy-around risk)

license.name: EP Prime Blinds and Specialties (EP Prime Investment Inc.)
license.registry: City of El Paso Accela Citizen Access, licensed professional search (Planning & Inspections contractor registration)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Business-name searches for 'EP Prime', 'EP Prime Investment', 'Prime Investment', 'Prime Blinds' and 'EP Blinds' returned no results. The search matches on the start of the name: a broader 'Prime' search returned 19 records, none of them this company. That points to no city contractor registration under these names. It may be registered under another name, or may not pull permits itself (blinds and specialties work may not need a permit). Ask the company for its El Paso registration number.

Likely supplies materials as part of its package bids (furnish-and-install)
